description: fx2-cmix fork with the byte stream unchanged and a fixed-seed Count-Min prefix sketch feeding four isolated mixer contexts keyed by decoded sidecar token recurrence and layout state.
deps: C++ runtime for the vendored cmix binary
source_changes: ContextManager maintains two deterministic Count-Min prefix sketches with fixed seed 1337: global token prefixes and layout-keyed token prefixes.
Decoded sidecar characters update sketch state without rewriting the compressed byte stream.
Four guarded mixer contexts consume sketch count buckets crossed with word length, XML field, template argument, and page kind.
verdict: Pruned as a mixer path. The fixed-seed sketch diagnostic has strong recurrence precision at 100MB, but the prefix-sketch mixer contexts increased archive size at both 250k and 1m gates.
